description: Domain registration date, age, registrar (RDAP) and email-auth records (MX, SPF, DMARC), which are common fraud signals, plus first_archived: the date of the Wayback Machine's earliest snapshot (null if none; archive.status says unavailable if archive.org didn't answer). notes holds factual remarks, such as a first snapshot under 90 days old or a registration years older than the first snapshot; they are not flags.
name: domain_age
title: Domain age and email records
